items.title: Frank Foster and Bill Hughes interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Schenectady, New York, March 28, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know Ruth? We were talking with Ruth...

ctx.x: I think there’s a big part of teaching that’s sometimes left out is just dealing with hearing and playing something from in here where, instead of off a sheet of paper. © Fillius Jazz Archive -16-

You know Ruth? We were talking with Ruth and basically what she said was when you play these notes, these notes are expensive. The notes cost you something. You know there’s an emotional price tag to those notes.
